content: {"summary":"The August 2025 outage was caused by an expired intermediate certificate that remained in the edge‑gateway pods because the renewal process only refreshed the leaf certificate and did not fetch or update the intermediate chain.","likely_cause":"Renewal mechanism omitted the intermediate certificate, leaving an expired intermediate in the served chain","confidence":"medium","claims":[{"text":"The outage was caused by an expired intermediate certificate served by all edge pods","evidence_ids":["INC-0068#1"],"quote":"the past date sitting on the intermediate the pods hand out"},{"text":"The renewal process only renewed the leaf certificate and did not update the intermediate chain","evidence_ids":["INC-0068#1"],"quote":"Renewing our own certificate and restarting the pods would have left clients facing the same dead intermediate"}],"next_checks":["Verify that the certificate renewal script fetches and stores the full certificate chain, including intermediates","Check the Secret `edge-public-tls` after renewal to ensure it contains updated intermediate certificates","Add monitoring for intermediate certificate expiry dates in addition to leaf expiry","Review rollout restart procedures to confirm pods are restarted after any certificate Secret change"]}
